model_selection_rationale: Random Forest selected: Achieved highest ROC-AUC (0.7310) and PR-AUC (0.7953) among all evaluated classifiers, alongside the highest Precision (84.19%). In supply chain operations, elevated precision prevents false alarms and unwarranted logistics expediting costs.

demand_forecast_evaluation.note: Evaluated on genuine daily calendar order counts (1,127 days total, Jan 2015 to Jan 2018). Reflects structural volume shift observed in Q4 2017.

strategies.name: First-Class Dynamic SLA Recalibration (+1 Day Buffer)
strategies.assumption: Revises promised First-Class delivery window from 1 day to 2 days based on empirical 2-day delivery transit times.
strategies.evidence_basis: Empirical DataCo ground truth confirms 100% of First-Class shipments complete in 2 days.

strategies.name: Standard-Class Modal Diversion (50% Volume Shift)
strategies.assumption: Diverts 50% of urgent First-Class non-critical shipments to Standard Class consolidated routing lanes.
strategies.evidence_basis: Standard Class achieves a 38.07% disruption rate vs 95.32% under First Class.

mitigation_experiment.data_requirements_note: Rigorous financial cost-benefit optimization requires real freight tariff matrices, holding costs, and contractual SLA penalty schedules not recorded in DataCo.

dropped_columns: Days for shipping (real) - directly encodes target
Benefit per order & Order Profit Per Order - post-delivery accounting realization
Sales per customer & Order Item Total - post-fulfillment invoice totals
Order Item Profit Ratio - dependent on realized post-order accounting margin
leakage_audit.safe_feature_justification: All 8 retained features represent parameters fixed prior to dispatch authorization and contain no post-order fulfillment or realization data.

data_source_label: DataCo Smart Supply Chain Dataset (Konstantinos Ferreira et al., Mendeley Data)
limitations: DataCo is an e-commerce/retail logistics dataset; Late_delivery_risk is mapped to supply chain delivery disruption risk.
Demand forecasting uses linear trend extrapolation and rolling averages on daily order volumes; advanced non-linear deep learning (LSTM/DeepAR) is indicated for production demand planning.
Supplier and component telemetry (SUP001-SUP008, P001-P006) represents simulated enterprise UI telemetry mapped to the real DataCo inference engine.
